shellProbe.purpose: Preliminary proof that the exact Node executable can run on Android. It cannot satisfy APK carrier readiness.

wxBoundary.decision: Do not extract a Node executable to filesDir/cacheDir and execve it. APK carrier code must be embedded in the APK native-code surface.

conclusion: ADB-shell executable success is preliminary only. Android carrier PASS requires the APK-embedded shared carrier plus a real app-UID JNI load/boot record.
